dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Honey was surrendered into care as a stray, so his previous history in a home environment is unknown. Honey has not acclimated well to the kennel environment and has only allowed minimal handling since intake. He remains significantly fearful and shut down and refuses to walk. We recommend placement with a new whole partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (Force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and reevaluate his behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.

**Meet Honey!**

Honey is a sweet, young brown-and-white boy who came to ACC as a stray after being found wet, shaking, and too frightened to stand or accept food. Since arriving, he has struggled to feel safe in the shelter and often shuts down, lying down and hesitating to move when brought out of his kennel.

Despite his fears, Honey has shown positive moments with people and recently enjoyed a successful dog-to-dog introduction, approaching another dog with a soft body and even offering playful bounces and play bows. He will need a patient, understanding placement where he can decompress, build confidence at his own pace, and receive gentle, force-free, reward-based support.

**Honey would benefit greatly from placement with a New Hope partner** who can help him feel safe and better understand his needs outside the shelter environment. He has so much potential, and a calm, supportive setting may give this sweet boy the chance he needs to come out of his shell.
dog.name: Honey
